bug_summary: The null-value fallback applied after deserialization now tests the parsed value token (t == JsonToken.VALUE_NULL) instead of whether the deserialized value is null, so the NullValueProvider handling only runs for literal JSON null tokens. Values that the value deserializer resolves to null without a null token, such as unknown enum values read as null or empty-string-to-null coercion, are buffered as raw nulls and bypass the configured provider: with Nulls.SKIP such entries are wrongly retained, and with Nulls.AS_EMPTY or Nulls.FAIL the configured replacement or failure is never applied. Handling of literal JSON null tokens is unchanged, so the existing null-value tests still pass.
